We need to find a template that when applied to the given molecule (initial_molecule) reproduces the forward reaction described (carbonyl-ene). We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (integer). The initial molecule is given with atom mapping numbers: [CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]

We need to find a retrosynthetic template that breaks the carbonyl-ene (i.e., reverse of forward). The forward: carbonyl-ene forms C-C bond and C-O bond, breaking C=C and C=O. So retrosynthesis: break C-C bond and C-O bond to give a carbonyl and an alkene (ene). So we need a template that does that.

We need to search template catalog by criteria: functional_groups_broken: ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"]; functional_groups_formed: ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "five-membered rings"]; bonds_broken: ["C=O","C=C"]; bonds_formed: ["C-O","C-C"]; bonds_order_changed maybe none.

But earlier attempts gave errors due to bond format. The tool expects bond format like "6-8". We don't know atom indices. Could omit bond criteria and just use functional groups. Let's try search with functional_groups_broken and formed only.
